rationale: All acceptance criteria met. Focus restores to nameButtonRef after pin/unpin via prevPinnedRef-guarded useEffect (AC-001, AC-002). useAnnouncementQueue + Announcement is the codebase-established polite live-region pattern (confirmed from RecordInput/FilesDropzone/useAnnouncementQueue source): clears region then sets via rAF, ensuring re-announcement of repeated values (AC-003, AC-004). Mount guard (prevPinnedRef.current === chat.pinned on init) prevents focus side-effect at mount (AC-005). Existing tests unchanged and pass (AC-006). Commit subject matches EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence pattern. No security issues. Four edge-case findings reviewed: (1) isEditing + null ref — ?. operator is already the safe guard, no focus-stealing occurs (DISMISS); (2) prevPinnedRef after remount — React key reconciliation prevents remount in this list, theoretical virtual-list edge only (DEFER); (3) announce/focus call order — both synchronous, rAF fires after regardless of ordering within the effect (DISMISS); (4) per-item aria-live regions — real JAWS concern for large lists, but RecordInput and FilesDropzone follow the same per-component pattern; a bounded refactor to a shared region is a follow-up improvement (DEFER). 1 deferred item logged.
